jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Operations FP&A
jobs.description:
From a small family business to a multi-billion-dollar global company, Sonoco has been changing the face of products and packaging since 1899 — all while keeping the heart of “People Build Businesses” alive.

Our talented people are at the core of our growth, constantly reinventing the Sonoco wheel with brilliant solutions every year. Today we are a world leader in global packaging solutions with diversified operations in over 34 countries. We're extremely proud of our portfolio of brands, our achievements in sustainability and industrialization and the groundbreaking work accomplished by our people.

While reporting directly to the Director, FP&A Operations, as the Financial Analyst, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence through a broad range of financial and operational analyses supporting manufacturing performance, working capital management, cash flow visibility, and strategic business decisions. Additional responsibilities include plant and cost reviews, manufacturing CAPEX support, procurement and structural transformation analyses, special project assignments, and financial process improvements.

What you'll be doing:
- Prepare and review LOH and cost analyses to support plant performance, cost visibility, margin improvement, and operational decision-making
- Support plant reviews by analyzing operating results, key financial drivers, manufacturing performance trends, risks, opportunities, and follow-up actions
- Conduct financial analyses and special project work for the divisions, including preparation of pro formas, discounted cash flows, OCF analyses, ROI evaluations, and business cases related to major expansions, acquisitions, divestitures, capital investments, and business valuations
- Support the manufacturing CAPEX process, including review of project assumptions, financial projections, approval documentation, capital policy compliance, and post-completion performance tracking
- Lead or support DSI, DPO, and broader working capital reviews to identify performance trends, improvement opportunities, and actions to optimize cash conversion
- Perform procurement analyses to evaluate material costs, supplier impacts, savings opportunities, inflation trends, and financial implications of sourcing decisions
- Support structural transformation initiatives by preparing financial models, validating cost savings, tracking benefits, and assessing impacts to operating performance and cash flow
- Develop and implement approaches and templates to improve financial reporting, forecasting, planning, analytics, and management review processes
- Undertake statistical analysis and analytical/industry research to support business planning, benchmarking, and strategic decision-making
- Assist with training of new manufacturing and sales personnel in Sonoco accounting and financial systems
- Other duties as assigned

This position can be located in Hartsville, SC or Charlotte, NC.

We would like to hear from you if:
- Four Year Undergraduate Degree in Accounting, Finance or Business or equivalent
- Preferred Certifications: CPA, CMA
- Individual has strong knowledge of Sonoco's business and/or experience in other manufacturing settings
- Experience with Oracle/OPM, Onestream, and QAD
- Strong technical aptitude and ability to grasp a general knowledge of multiple disciplines and technologies
- Strong analytical and critical skills that drive a continuous improvement mindset
- Treasury/Cash Management background a plus but not required
- Manufacturing Operations background a plus but not required

Compensation:

Analyst -Financial: The annual base salary range for this role is from $67,760 to $76,230.
Analyst II - Financial: The annual base salary range for this role is from $88,000 to $99,000.
Analyst III - Financial: The annual base salary range for this role is from $107,760 to $121,230, plus annual target bonus of 7.5% of base salary.
Senior Financial Analyst: The annual base salary range for this role is from $122,320 to $137,610, plus annual target bonus of 7.5% of base salary.
This is a progression position and level will be based on candidate experience and business needs.

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst Trainee (Internship)
jobs.description:
About Sonoco
Sonoco is a global packaging leader with more than 125 years of experience delivering innovative packaging solutions to customers worldwide. Operating across both consumer and industrial markets, Sonoco combines global scale, deep industry expertise, and a strong commitment to sustainability to create value for customers and consumers alike.
With a diversified portfolio spanning consumer packaging, industrial paper solutions, and metal packaging, Sonoco is focused on operational excellence, innovation, and long-term growth. Our success is built on strong customer partnerships, continuous improvement, and the talent of our people.
Joining Sonoco means becoming part of a global organization where collaboration, accountability, and innovation are highly valued. Our teams work together to solve challenges, drive progress, and shape the future of packaging.

Position Details:
The candidate needs to be enrolled at university
Position: Trainee Treasury Analyst
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Department: Treasury EMEA/APAC
Duration: 6-month internship
Start Date: As soon as possible
Reporting to: Treasury Manager and Treasury Director (Paris)

We are seeking a motivated Treasury Analyst Trainee to join our EMEA/APAC Treasury team. The successful candidate will support the Treasury Analysts and gain hands-on experience across all key treasury activities, including cash management, treasury operations, banking relationships, compliance, and reporting.

Key Responsibilities
1. Cash & Liquidity Management
- Update, adjust, and forecast daily cash positions using multiple banking platforms.
- Upload and reconcile daily bank statements.
- Investigate and resolve cash flow discrepancies with local business units and banking partners.
- Process bank transfer requests and ensure compliance with payment security procedures.
- Create and maintain secure payment templates.
- Verify Standard Settlement Instructions (SSIs).
- Support the monitoring and optimization of cash pooling structures.

2. Treasury Market Operations & Back Office
- Monitor Foreign Exchange (FX), Interest Rate (IR), and Commodities transactions within the Treasury Management System.
- Prepare dealing tickets for FX and commodity transactions.
- Process credit advices and monitor premium fixings.
- Follow up on maturing FX transactions and coordinate with internal stakeholders regarding settlement, rollover, or maturity decisions.
- Ensure trade data accuracy and completeness in treasury systems.

3. Treasury Reporting, Netting & Controls
- Participate in the monthly intercompany netting process.
- Analyze netting data and manage related approval workflows.
- Prepare monthly treasury activity reports covering FX, commodities, and other treasury activities.
- Perform SOX controls and ensure treasury documentation is complete and properly approved.
- Monitor and report monthly interest payments.

4. Corporate Banking, Compliance & Treasury Projects
- Support bank account management activities, including account openings and closures.
- Maintain treasury banking databases and account inventories.
- Assist with KYC documentation and compliance reviews.
- Coordinate with banks and internal stakeholders to obtain required treasury documentation.
- Support treasury projects, including banking RFPs and credit facility requests.
- Assist business units with treasury-related requests and banking matters.

Who Are We Looking For?
You are an enthusiastic, proactive student looking to gain practical experience within an international treasury environment.

Requirements
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Finance or a related field.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Results-oriented with a proactive mindset.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
- Interest in corporate treasury, banking, and financial markets.
- Experience with Treasury Management Systems (TMS), particularly Kyriba, is a plus.
- Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

What We Offer
- Exposure to a global treasury organization covering EMEA and APAC.
- Hands-on experience in cash management, FX, commodities, banking, and treasury operations.
- Mentorship from experienced treasury professionals.
- Opportunity to work with leading international banks and treasury systems.
- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
- Valuable experience to launch a career in Corporate Treasury.

Join Sonoco and build the foundations of your treasury career in a truly international environment.

#LI-AO1

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
Position: Supply Chain Manager

Position Summary:
Reporting directly to the Plant Manager, as a Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for identifying and securing new sources of recovered paper, as well as managing the flow of quality recovered paper to Sonoco paper mills in the region which assigned. Achieves the most cost-effective supply plans for all paper mills assigned to support.  Works closely with mill managers and other mill recovered materials personnel to maintain a high level of understanding of mill requirements.  In conjunction with suppliers and mill personnel, is responsible for coordinating and communicating all raw material downgrades and rejections in an effort to keep quality at its best.

What you'll be doing:
- Capacity Management of demand through Sales and Operations Planning

- Review and authorize production schedules for shop floor use

- Development of existing supply chain processes and procedures

- Balance customer demand with supply using MRP logic

- Stock build management for seasonal business

- Maintain and improve Bill of Material accuracy

- Maintain inventory stock at business plan levels

- Resolving booking and system process flow issues

- Control working capital by optimal planning of inventory

- Develop relationships between Customer Service, Sales Managers and Production area

- Analysis of supply chain issues

- Order of direct and indirect materials

- Warehouse management of on-site and off-site inventory and FLT contract

- Allocating and managing staff resources according to business demand

- Managing staff training and discipline issues

- Responsible for inbound and outbound logistics operations, such as transportation, warehouse, safety and logistics quality management

- Work with purchasing to understand opportunities to eliminate cost through consignment stock and substitute materials

- A proactive problem solving approach to supply chain management issues, with an ability to resolve using IT systems.

- Prepare for and chair daily morning Supply Chain meeting

jobs.title: Supply Chain Specialist
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Specialist
Drive supply chain transformation across Europe
Looking for a role where you'll take ownership, work on meaningful projects, and gain exposure to different areas of the business?
At Sonoco, you'll join an international team driving change across our European operations. From digital transformation and process optimization to implementing new planning tools and data-driven technologies, you'll be at the heart of projects that shape how our business works.
Why join Sonoco?
At Sonoco, we create innovative and sustainable packaging solutions used by some of the world's most recognized brands.
With over 19,000 employees in 34 countries, we're a global company with a strong focus on innovation, operational excellence, and sustainability.
Within our European Supply Chain organization, we're continuously improving the way we plan, produce, and deliver products across multiple manufacturing sites and markets. Through strategic projects and continuous improvement initiatives, we're shaping the future of our operations.
You'll work across departments and collaborate with teams across Europe, gaining exposure to different areas of the business such as logistics, manufacturing, planning, and finance. Along the way, you'll broaden your perspective and gain valuable experience in an international environment.
What you'll get
- Fast-track learning and development
- Opportunities to lead projects and drive real improvements
- Strong career growth potential within a global organization
- International exposure with occasional travel to Sonoco locations across Europe
- Flexible hybrid working arrangements
- Collaboration with experts from different functions and countries
- Hands-on experience with Oracle ERP and advanced planning systems

What you'll be doing
As a Supply Chain Specialist, you'll join a small team that works closely with manufacturing sites and cross-functional stakeholders to drive improvement projects across our European operations.
Your responsibilities:
- Dive deep into Sonoco's end-to-end supply chain processes
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, performance, and costs
- Support and lead strategic improvement projects
- Explore and support the use of digital tools, data analytics, and emerging technologies to improve supply chain performance.
- Drive change management initiatives and support teams through transformation
- Build expertise in Oracle ERP and other key planning systems
- Ensure high-quality and reliable supply chain data across the business

Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who's curious, analytical, and excited to solve complex challenges.
You would be a great fit if you:
- Hold a master’s degree in engineering, economics, logistics, supply chain, business, or a related field
- Recent graduate or early-career professional
- Enjoy solving problems and turning data into actionable insights
- Have strong analytical and project management skills
- Comfortable working in a dynamic environment and able to adapt to change
- Communicate clearly and collaborate well with different stakeholders
- Show initiative and a strong sense of ownership
- Speak fluent English
- Have experience with ERP systems (a plus, not a requirement)

Most importantly, you're eager to learn, grow, and make an impact.

Join our team
If you're looking for a role where you'll gain real responsibility, learn from experienced professionals, and contribute to meaningful transformation projects across Europe, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV in English

jobs.description:
Als Komplettanbieter von innovativen Verpackungslösungen ist SONOCO ein weltweit tätiger Anbieter von Konsumgüterverpackungen, industriellen Produkten und Lieferkettendienstleistungen mit mehreren Milliarden US-Dollar Jahresumsatz. Wir stellen an mehr als 70 europäischen Standorten Verpackungen für eine Vielzahl von Branchen und zahlreiche der angesehensten Marken der Welt her, die an Kunden in 85 Ländern geliefert werden. An den Standorten Hockenheim und Lübeck werden Papierdosen für zahlreiche namhafte Lebensmittel- Tabak- und andere Herstelle der Konsumgütersparte produziert. An unserem Standort in Zwenkau wiederrum werden Lebensmittelverkaufsverpackungen aus recyclefähigem Kunststoff erstellt, wie zum Beispiel Verpackungen für Joghurt, Wurst- und Käseprodukte oder Speiseeis.

While reporting to the Global Sustainability Manager, the Global Sustainability Compliance Specialist will have a focus on product sustainability and supports Sonoco’s global sustainable packaging activities across the corporation.  The Sustainability Specialist manages internal and external stakeholder engagement on sustainability-related aspects of Sonoco’s packaging.  This includes but is not limited to developing internal and external communication supporting the Sonoco’s sustainability efforts, managing tool development on sustainability-related databases, coordinating compliance activities, and reporting sustainability activities across the business. This position handles moderate to complex issues and problems, and refers more complex issues to higher-level staff. Performs work under limited supervision.

What you'll be doing:
- Support the execution of Sonoco’s global sustainable packaging strategy and business unit-level regulatory needs

- Review global legal requirements, with a special focus on packaging design (PPWR), extended producer responsibility (EPR), reporting (CSRD), supply chains (EUDR, CSDDD) and external communication (EmpCo), and coordinate implementation in collaboration with internal stakeholders

- Collect and analyze market and customer insights to collaborate with business units developing sustainable products which meet legal requirements, market expectation and corporate goals

- Handle customer requests and optimize documentation and feedback processes using modern IT tools

- Represent Sonoco in selected associations of the packaging industry; monitor of and contribute to the relevant focus areas

- Support with the organization of internal guidelines, webinars, trainings, newsletters

- Support trials and recyclability investigations on lab or industrial scale globally

- Support with the global coordination of SEDEX / SMETA activities in Sonoco

- Identify and implement continuous improvements

This is an onsite position located in Hockenheim, Germany or Paris, France .

We'd love to hear from you if:
- Willingness to travel (10%)
- BS or BA degree with a background of sustainability

- 2 to 4 years of experience with sustainability and/or regulatory compliance principles, preferably in the context of packaging
- Language: Native language + English
- Interest to identify and analyze information, including legislation and industry standards
- Ability to effectively communicate findings and key issues both internally and externally

- Aptitude to support the development of novel concepts and solutions

- Ability to build collaborative relationships globally

- Ability to effectively network internally to gain support in achieving objectives

- Ability to mediate between technical, commercial and sustainability requirements

jobs.description:
Logistic Senior Sourcing Specialist - European Sourcing
Poland(Goleniow, Kutno, Gdansk)

Are you a smart, savvy Sourcing expert, able to quickly grasp business opportunities and solve problems, communicate with clarity, lead & influence others across complex organisation ? Then come and be part of our Indirect Sourcing team.
Our Company’s Sourcing Division aims to find and establish suppliers that meet organisation needs, quality, service and commercial requirements, at the lowest overall cost.
In the context of the Sourcing organisation enhancement and development, we are looking for a new purchasing manager to support our development.

Primary responsibilities will be around logistic categories (inc. transportation, warehousing, forklifts,…) in Poland, Germany and Belgium. The selected candidate may also be have to support some initiatives in other indirect categories (MRO, Packaging, services,…) as well as lead European projects/commodities as needed and depending on profile.

RESPONSIBILITIES ON ATTRIBUTED CATEGORIES:
- Define and Support the execution of Sourcing strategies
- Identify & lead sourcing projects including activities from RFP, negotiations, contracting, supplier relationship management to claim management, …
- Drive cost opportunities, synergies, challenge the status quo (where appropriate) in partnership with the sourcing team and internal stakeholders to bring value and productivity for the business.
- Develop Supplier partnership through negotiation of new supply agreement and management of existing ones including securing capacity.
- Monitor and review suppliers' performances with operations with reference to the agreed standard and service levels.
- Liaise effectively externally with suppliers, other sourcing members as well as internal stakeholders
- Effectively build and communicate complex information to internal stakeholders to facilitate understanding and decision-making
- Support business (sales, operations,…) objectives with efficient, cost effective solutions at the required service & quality levels
- Ensure compliance to policies, adherence to Group systems and standards
- Manage invoicing and claim issues with suppliers as well as feed Market Intelligence on suppliers capabilities, competition, technology
- Conduct & communicate budgeting exercise, reporting, data management including pricing control
- Ensure continuous improvement through better control, reporting in partnership with capability/back office team

PROFILE/SKILLS REQUIRED:
- University degree in Procurement/Sourcing, Supply Chain, Business or Engineering related field
- Sourcing experience: 5years minimum
- Demonstrated learning agility working in complex & diverse environment
- Reasonable level of technical knowledge and good project management skills,
- Good leadership, communication & influencing skills
- Ability to effectively communicate and present information to all levels.
- Ability to think strategically whilst remaining close to operations
- Demonstrated team player abilities
- Data driven with strong analytical skills and use of tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, AI, etc.)
- Continuous improvement mind-set
- Strong self-management & problem-solving
- Ability to travel (25% on average)
- ERP knowledge (Oracle, JDE, SAP…)

Fluent In English & Polish; Other languages (German, French,…) are a strong plus
